headline: Market closed for weekend; crude oil trends, West Asia situation, and IPO rush in focus next week

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 21 September.

why: Indian stock markets are closed today, Sunday, September 20, 2026, on account of the weekend.
Crude oil price movements and West Asia geopolitical developments are set to drive market direction in the upcoming week.
Primary market momentum remains strong with multiple IPOs lined up for subscription.
Traders are tracking upcoming corporate actions and GIFT Nifty signals ahead of Monday's session.
whatHappening: NMDC is targeting an iron ore production mark of 60 million tonnes for the current fiscal year.
Six companies have lined up mainboard IPOs worth ₹3,825 crore amid brisk primary market activity.
A total of 19 IPO issues are scheduled to open for subscription this week with NSE leading 12 listings.
Multiple corporate actions are scheduled this week for stocks including Bajaj Holdings, Dixon Tech, and Titagarh Rail Systems.
summary: Markets are closed today for the weekend and trading will resume on Monday, 21 September. Primary market activity remains strong with multiple IPOs and corporate actions lined up for the coming week. Global cues, including crude oil prices and West Asia geopolitical developments, will guide market sentiment.
